rows.grounds: indeclinable indicating manner; refers to the preceding statement or practice
first member in a series denoting locations beginning with the heart
locative plural of ādi, indicating the heart and other locations

items.question: In which locations is the preceding practice applied in this manner?
premises: The term evaṃ indicates application in the stated manner.
The term hṛdaya names the heart as a location.
The term ādiṣu extends the application to other locations.
items.inference: The preceding practice is applied in this manner in the heart and other specified locations.
uncertainties: The specific additional locations implied by ādiṣu are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Thus in the heart and so forth.
